title: DMR / dPMR / NXDN events
description: Validated against the complete event object (envelope included). A call produces one dsd.call.start when its link control is decoded and one dsd.call.end (same call id and fields, plus the outcome) when it is over. DMR has two slots, so calls on both can overlap.

call.description: Id of the call (its start time in Unix ms, plus the slot for DMR).

dst.description: Destination ID: the talkgroup of a group call, a radio ID for a private call.

group.description: True for a group call (dst is a talkgroup), false for a private call.

encrypted.description: The call is encrypted (privacy flag or algorithm seen).

algorithm.description: Encryption algorithm as the decoder printed it, for example 0x21.

muted.description: True when the audio was withheld (encrypted call).
